name: locust yoga pose (iron man pose)
description: A yoga pose on your belly where you lift legs and chest at once. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms along your sides and palms facing up.
Press your pelvis into the floor and engage your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor together.
Look slightly forward and keep your neck long.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower slowly and rest.
